title: Print forms and training-version limits
goal: Prepare a readable report and reconcile its facts while respecting edition limits.
prerequisites: onec.p8; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
sections: Presentation is not the source of truth

A print form presents selected data state; it does not replace source documents or modify them for formatting. State generation time, number, customer, units and total. Later source changes do not automatically update an older exported snapshot.

Label the own30/45 set with customer key, period and minutes. A spreadsheet document displays results but does not become the accounting source. Do not parse formatted/rounded text back into subsequent calculations.

Displaying 600.00does not turn text into a number or define rounding. Compute under the contract before formatting for locale. Test long names, line wrapping and zero totals. A visually empty cell must not stand for a legitimate zero without an explicit rule.

Reconcile references and2/75 before inspecting order, headings, long synthetic names and zero versus missing. For monetary examples, rounding belongs to the module3 calculation contract; formatting belongs to presentation.

Training edition restricts runtime spreadsheet-document printing/saving. Check the exact build and official terms rather than promising every client an export. Use another permitted original reconciliation protocol where needed. Do not bypass limits with patches or call a screenshot a proven document export.

Open the own report and Generate. If the official edition permits Print/Save, use standard preview and a separate result file. Training editions may restrict this: record unavailability and reconcile on screen without bypassing limits.

In a permitted environment, generate, save by a supported route and reopen. Reconcile identities, units and totals, not merely file existence. If unavailable, explain clearly and preserve source data. Native generation, physical printing and export require distinct evidence.

Reread requests and confirm report viewing changed no durations. Retain only synthetic screenshots and command availability with version. Missing print support neither validates a wrong total nor makes Sandbox mandatory.
